results.contact_interpretation: A terminal boundary contact ends the test even if the sampled state is still on the admissible equality. No-violation-up-to-stop does not mean complete safe recovery.
results.recovery_rule_clarification: Official conservative common score requires both 50ms self-cycle convergence and return to pre-fault target for sag, each<=1e-5, plus three qualifying checks and a safe/unclipped150ms window. Target-only time is separately shown; no dynamics or threshold was changed.
results.battery_note: Actual stored battery energy, passive integrals, and SoC are retained and bounded, but excluded from electrical orbit recurrence. Constant positive P keeps depleting inventory. See paired no-fault energy accounting for disturbance debt/surplus.
